description_en: Queries the result of an asynchronous task for generating synchronization task configurations
name: QueryDISyncTaskConfigProcessResult

parameters.help_en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object that you want to create or update in Data Integration in asynchronous mode. Valid values:

DI_REALTIME: real-time synchronization task

DI_SOLUTION: synchronization solution DataWorks allows you to create or update real-time synchronization tasks and synchronization solutions in Data Integration only in asynchronous mode.

Valid values:

DI_OFFLINE

DI_REALTIME

DI_SOLUTION
parameters.help_zh:
异步方式创建或更新的同步任务的任务类型。取值如下：
DI_REALTIME：表示实时同步任务。
DI_SOLUTION：表示解决方案同步任务。
仅支持使用异步方式创建或更新数据集成实时同步任务和解决方案同步任务
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
The asynchronous thread ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383463.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383464.html operation to obtain the ID.

The GenerateDISyncTaskConfigForCreating operation is used to generate the ID of the asynchronous thread that is used to create a real-time synchronization task in Data Integration.

The GenerateDISyncTaskConfigForUpdating operation is used to generate the ID of the asynchronous thread that is used to update a real-time synchronization task in Data Integration
parameters.help_zh:
异步线程的ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383463.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/383464.html接口获取ID。
GenerateDISyncTaskConfigForCreating：表示创建数据集成同步任务。
GenerateDISyncTaskConfigForUpdating：表示更新数据集成同步任务
parameters.name: async_process_id

Data.description_en: The information returned for the parameters that are asynchronously generated and used to create or update a real-time synchronization task in Data Integration
Data.description_zh: 获取异步生成或更新数据集成同步任务所需参数的返回结果

Message.description_en: The reason why the parameters fail to be obtained. If the parameters are obtained, the value null is returned
Message.description_zh: 获取异步生成或更新数据集成同步任务所需参数失败的原因描述。如果获取成功，则该参数的返回值为空

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the parameters are obtained. Valid values:

success: The parameters are obtained.

fail: The parameters fail to be obtained. You can view the reason for the failure and troubleshoot the issue based on the reason
Status.description_zh:
获取异步生成或更新数据集成同步任务所需参数的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示成功获取相关参数。
fail：表示获取相关参数失败。您可以查看失败原因，处理相关问题

TaskContent.description_en: The parameters that are obtained. The parameters are used as the request parameters of the [CreateDISyncTask]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/278725.html） or [UpdateDISyncTask]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/289109.html） operation to create or update a real-time synchronization task in Data Integration
TaskContent.description_zh: 异步线程生成的数据集成同步任务所需参数。该参数将作为[CreateDISyncTask]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/278725.html）或[UpdateDISyncTask]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/289109.html）接口的输入参数，用于后续创建或更新数据集成同步任务

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can locate logs and troubleshoot issues based on the ID
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。取值如下：
true：成功。
false：失败
